name: LADIES SIDER
description:
High-quality PU leather se bana stylish handbag. Isme spacious main compartment, secure zip closure, strong top handle aur adjustable shoulder strap diya gaya hai. Elegant tassel design aur premium finish is bag ko aur bhi attractive banati hai. Daily use, office, college, shopping, travel aur party wear ke liye perfect choice. Lightweight, durable aur comfortable carry karne ke liye design kiya gaya hai. 
• Premium Quality PU Leather
• Elegant Tassel Design
• Secure Zip Closure
• Spacious Main Compartment
• Adjustable Shoulder Strap
• Comfortable Top Handle
• Lightweight & Durable
• Perfect for Office, College & Daily Use
• Ideal for Shopping, Travel & Party Wear
• Fine Stitching with Premium Finish
